title: The 1928 Law That Made It Illegal to Be Born Poor
hook: In 1928 a government passed a law declaring poverty a hereditary crime—and children of the poor were taken away to be 're-educated' in labor camps.

why_this_can_go_viral: People love stories about hidden puppet masters, and salt is a surprisingly relatable everyday substance turned into a weapon.

title: The Secret Society That Controlled All Cats—To Spy on Every Home
